incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — HIGH: embedder-serving error spike in usa-west-2 (error rate 12%). Auto-run mitigation applied. page: eng-oncall
eng-oncall: Acked. I'm taking this.
alex: looking at logs now, seeing 504s from embedder-host-4, likely oom/killer?
maria: +1; memory pressure metric spiked at 11:12:03, PID 2378 restarted by systemd.
jamal: Repro steps I'm running:
```
kubectl -n redwood logs embedder-deploy-4 -c embedder --since=10m
curl https://internal-metrics/host/embedder-host-4 | jq '.memory'
```
jamal: If it's OOM, can we evict cache quickly to reduce memory?
eng-oncall: Doing a rolling restart of the pod to drain KV cache and let it warm back. Initiating: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embedder-deploy -n redwood`
sophia: FYI customer-impact: three customers on dedicated pools reported increased latency and a retry surge. Working on a list and contacting account leads.
alex: Can we hotfix config to limit kv cache size until we get a longer-term fix? Suggest set KV_MAX_BYTES=4G on embedder config.
maria: Patching config now to set KV_MAX_BYTES=4G and enable aggressive GC. Applying patch to canary first.
eng-oncall: Canary patch applied to embedder-deploy-canary; metrics look stable for 2m. Rolling to pool-1.
product-ops: Scheduling post-incident review — can we lock a 60-min slot tomorrow 16:00 PT? Need action items and owners.
jamal: Action item start: root cause investigation (mem leak vs bad shard placement) owner: jamal, estimate: 3d.
alex: Action item: short-term mitigation (kv cap + restart orchestration) owner: alex, estimate: 2d (includes monitoring alert tuning).
maria: Action item: add OOM detector to embedder supervisor + heap snapshot on restart, owner: maria, estimate: 1.5d.
sophia: Action item: customer outreach + credit assessment, owner: sophia, estimate: 0.5d.
eng-oncall: Adding triage label severity=P2 now that rolling restart resolved immediate spike; will create post-incident ticket and link actions.
product-ops: For quarterly planning tie-in: please flag any action items that need infra budget or dedicated cycles; we'll map to Q2 plan.
jamal: Flagging RC investigation as needs-infra (could require deeper profiling on dedicated GPUs).
alex: Note for sizing: RC 3d but may split into 1d triage + 2d deep analysis. Mark as medium.
maria: I'll open follow-up tickets and attach logs + snapshot.
eng-oncall: Closing pager. If anything else pops, re-page. Thanks all :thumbsup:
product-ops: Confirmed postmortem meeting scheduled tomorrow 16:00 PT. Please add preliminary notes to the ticket before EOD.
